versions.changelog:
flyai-skipticket 1.0.0

- Initial release of the FlyAI skill for searching hidden city/skip-lag (弃程票) tickets within China.
- Compares only direct flight prices and hidden city ticket prices, excluding regular connecting flights.
- Activates when users request "弃程票", "隐藏城市票", or "跳城票".
- Provides clear definitions, selection strategies for "further cities", and output format for price comparisons.
- Strongly emphasizes critical risks and best practices for using hidden city tickets.
